name: Physics
description: The natural science of matter, motion, and energy.

name: Classical Mechanics
description: The study of the motion of macroscopic objects.

name: Kinematics
description: The branch of mechanics that describes the motion of points, bodies, and systems of bodies.

name: Optics
description: The branch of physics that studies the behaviour and properties of light.

name: Thermodynamics
description: The branch of physics that deals with heat, work, and temperature.
